title: Japanese-Style Roasted Quinoa Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious quinoa bowl inspired by Japanese cuisine, featuring roasted vegetables and a savory sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato, carrots, and purple cabbage with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly caramelized.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of sesame oil.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked quinoa in the bottom, followed by the roasted vegetables, and drizzle with the soy sauce mixture.
Garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
